name: bm25-skeleton-mcp
description: 2-Tier Codebase Representation, Skeleton DSL & BM25 Search MCP Plugin

tools.name: get_file_skeleton
tools.description: Get token-efficient Skeleton DSL with cross-references ([L15-L42], # calls:, # used_by:) for a specific file

tools.name: get_symbol_contour
tools.description: Get Skeleton DSL contour for symbols matching a query name or qualname

query.description: Symbol name or query to build contour for

limit.description: Maximum number of matching symbols to include

tools.name: search_codebase
tools.description: Search codebase files and text content using BM25 scoring and return excerpts

tools.name: ask_codebase
tools.description: Answer natural language architectural questions over the codebase and return Skeleton DSL

tools.name: get_index_stats
tools.description: Get current index statistics (file count, symbol count, BM25 status)
